pr.title: fix(core-flows): harden create payment sessions when customer has no account holders
pr.body:
## What
- Treat missing `customer.account_holders` as `[]` before calling `.find()` in `createPaymentSessionsWorkflow`.
- Use optional chaining on the holder and workflow `input` in the find predicate so transform resolution cannot throw on `provider_id` (see issue follow-up).

## Why
Logged-in customers with no `account_holder` rows can get `account_holders === undefined` from the remote query; the workflow previously called `.find` on `undefined` and returned 500 on `POST /store/payment-collections/:id/payment-sessions`. A second failure mode on `provider_id` is described in the issue thread.

## How
`packages/core/core-flows/src/payment-collection/workflows/create-payment-session.ts`

## Testing
- [ ] Not run locally (integration env). CI / maintainers can run module integration tests if needed.
- Regression context: `integration-tests/modules/__tests__/payment/payment-session.workflows.spec.ts` (comment references #15152).

Fixes #15152

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches the payment-session creation workflow; while the change is small and defensive, it affects a critical checkout path and could alter account-holder selection behavior if customer data is unexpectedly shaped.
> 
> **Overview**
> Fixes a regression in `createPaymentSessionsWorkflow` where the remote customer query can return `account_holders` as `undefined`, causing a runtime error when searching for an existing holder.
> 
> The workflow now treats missing `account_holders` as an empty list and uses optional chaining in the `.find()` predicate; an integration test comment was updated to document the regression, and a patch changeset was added for `@medusajs/core-flows`.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 5ff5b75b24eea44d61e21c9be5060c6447acf71d. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

commits.message:
fix(core-flows): handle undefined customer account_holders in payment sessions workflow

Use [] when account_holders is missing, and optional chaining on holder and workflow input in the .find predicate so resolution cannot throw (#15152, including issue follow-up on provider_id).

Fixes #15152
commits.author: suh016

commits.message: chore(core-flows): use non-optional input.provider_id in account holder find
commits.author: suh016

commits.message: test(integration): cover #15152 customer with no account_holder links
commits.author: suh016
